budget.rationale: The six cost categories add up to an estimated $7,100–$9,600, keeping even the high end below the $12,000 target. Icelandair has published June 2027 pricing, while lodging and rental-car costs still need live quotes.

weather.rationale: The headline days are exposed to cool air, wind, rain and spray. A full buffer day helps, but weather can still cancel the glacier or materially reshape the Golden Circle and coast days.

fireRisk.rationale: Very low is the safety rating (5/5), corresponding to a <2% planning chance of material wildfire disruption during the exact trip window. Iceland has had rare large grass fires, but its maritime climate, sparse tree cover, and limited fire history make wildfire a very small June travel risk. Volcanic hazards remain important, but they stay in the separate general Risk axis.

swim.rationale: Natural ocean water is too cold and unsafe for family swimming, but the route schedules warm municipal geothermal pools and Secret Lagoon. That is meaningful heated/geothermal swimming rather than warm natural sea swimming.

variety.rationale: The seven-night route schedules a city/harbour, geothermal swimming, geysers, waterfalls, glacier ice, black coast and volcanic terrain. Culture and food are lighter than nature, bounding the score at 4/5.

ease.rationale: A nonstop outbound flight, one round-trip rental and only two hotel changes keep the week manageable. Using the Golden Circle as the drive to Hella avoids backtracking, and the final Keflavík night makes departure morning easy.

food.rationale: Every base has pizza, burgers, fries and grocery coverage, and the route explicitly carries picnic food on remote days. Icelandic prices and thin hours outside Reykjavík prevent a higher score.

risk.rationale: The exact PIT–KEF nonstop is sold in both directions. Wind, road, surf and volcanic conditions still require daily checks, but schedule uncertainty is now low enough for Risk 4/5.

nights.rationale: Seven hotel nights are intentionally compact. The main comparison rewards longer vacations, so every trip of eight nights or fewer receives 1/5 on this measure.

novelty.rationale: Iceland is entirely new to the family, earning the strongest score for novelty.

pto.rationale: The observed Juneteenth holiday keeps this seven-night trip to five vacation days, an excellent time-off fit.
